name: Chronic Kidney Disease
algorithm: Ensemble of SVM + Random Forest + XGBoost + ANN (soft voting)
dataset: UCI Chronic Kidney Disease dataset (Apollo Hospitals, Tamil Nadu, India)
population: 400 patients, southern India, 25 attributes collected over 2 months
caveats: Only 400 patients; this dataset is known to be almost linearly separable, so the reported accuracy is optimistic for real-world early-stage CKD.

metrics.validation: 5-fold stratified cross-validation x5 repeats (held-out folds only)
